rules.method: Read each complete response against its exact prompt, visible code and repository rules. Preserve response/model/prompt hashes and case-specific reasoning.
rules.production_usable: Unchanged production parseReview accepts the complete response and available changed-line citations.
rules.genuine_issue_detected: At least one supported concrete mechanism with an available causally appropriate citation, even if unsupported extras spoil the complete review.
rules.full_review_pass: Concern: production accepted, real cited issue, every material claim/finding supported, no unsupported extra findings. Clean: production accepted empty findings.
rules.pairs: Both concern and clean must pass fully; separately report mere presence and token decisions.
rules.alternatives: Gold wording and canonical citation are not mandatory; any changed line with a valid causal connection is allowed, including either side of harmful no-op replacements.
rules.precision: Awkward but meaningful explanations can pass. Separate detected real issues from inaccurate elaborations; retain explicitly reasoned sensitivity judgments if a claim is ambiguous.

explicit_boundaries: Production parser acceptance is necessary for full review pass; preserve all raw output, including duplicate keys; parsed last JSON key wins as in production JavaScript.
Concern detection requires a concrete supported causal connection and valid changed-line citation, not merely quoting a rule or removed line.
Clean requires accepted empty findings. A confidence value Clean or prose saying clean in a nonempty finding does not satisfy this.
Gold wording and canonical citations are not mandatory. Awkward meaningful causal relations may pass, with strict alternatives retained when meaning is ambiguous.
Read every full prompt and full raw response separately before assigning judgments. Do not consult another judge before all 48 own judgments.
The 24 repeated holdout examples are diagnostic, not untouched confirmation data. Do not reconstruct or assume missing previous raw outputs.
pair_rule: Both members of a concern/clean pair must individually pass fully; report pair results only after both are read.
